summary: Tested new Command Center (backend /api/command-center + /dashboard UI) and Class schedule fields. Backend: 10/11 pytest checks pass (structure, stats consistency, schedule sorting/enrichment, at-risk, assignments-to-grade, recommendations, class schedule create/update persistence, auth guard). Frontend: login as test@school.edu lands on /dashboard rendering Command Center with Quick Stats (0 Classes Today, 0/0 Attendance, 17 To Grade, 3 At Risk), 'No classes today' empty state (Saturday - expected), Students at Risk with severity badges, Assignments to Grade with progress bars, AI Recommendations (2 items), and all 4 Quick Actions navigating correctly. Two real defects found in Classes schedule fields: (1) creating a class with the Period field left blank returns 422 and blocks creation, (2) Class Edit dialog populates schedule values but handleUpdateClass never sends period/start_time/end_time so schedule edits are silently discarded while showing a success toast.

critical.issue: 422 int_parsing when frontend sends period:'' (blank Period field in Add Class dialog). Class creation without a period is impossible from the UI. Fix in frontend (send null/omit) or coerce empty string to None in ClassCreate validator.

minor.issue: today/today_weekday computed in UTC (datetime.now(timezone.utc)); for a Puerto Rico/US teacher the 'today' schedule and attendance date can be off by one day late evening/early morning.

At-risk grade average assumes every assignment is out of 100 points (max_points = len(grades)*100) instead of using each assignment's 'points'; averages/severity can be wrong for non-100-point assignments.

N+1 query pattern: per-class students/assignments/grades/attendance loops plus per-assignment count_documents (2 queries each). Will not scale for teachers with many classes/assignments; consider aggregation.

ui_bugs.issue: newClass.period defaults to '' and is posted as-is -> POST /api/classes 422; only a generic 'Error' toast is shown (no field-level message), user cannot create a class without entering a Period.

PUT payload only contains name/grade/section/subject/year_term. Verified request body: {"name":"TEST_UI_WithSchedule","grade":"6","section":"Q","subject":"","year_term":"2024-2025"} - period/start_time/end_time are dropped, so schedule edits never persist (values reverted to 2/09:00 after reload) while a 'Class updated' success toast is shown.
No UI control for days_of_week; classes always default to Mon-Fri, so a class meeting only on some days (or Sat/Sun) cannot be configured, yet Command Center filters strictly by day of week.

Missing data-testid on Quick Stats cards, Today's Schedule / Students at Risk / Assignments to Grade / AI Recommendations containers and their empty states; verification had to rely on body text matching.

integration_issues.issue: CommandCenter.js uses `const API = ${window.location.origin}/api` instead of process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (violates env-var rule; breaks if frontend is served from a different origin than the API).
fetchCommandCenter only console.errors on failure; loading ends with data=null and the page silently renders all-zero stats/empty panels with no error state or retry.

issues: Today's Schedule card is stretched to match the right column height, leaving ~400px of empty whitespace under the 'No classes today' empty state on weekends
Duplicate student entry ('Maria Garcia' listed twice from English 4A) in Students at Risk - likely duplicate student records; consider de-duplicating or showing student number for disambiguation
Student with 63.5% average + 5 missing is badged 'High' risk which reads inconsistently with its per-factor 'medium/low' severity chips

action_items: Classes.js: omit/null period (and empty time strings) when blank before POST /api/classes, or add a Pydantic validator coercing '' -> None; surface the API detail in the error toast.
Classes.js handleUpdateClass: include period, start_time, end_time (and days_of_week) in the PUT payload so schedule edits persist.
CommandCenter.js: use process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL instead of window.location.origin and add an error/retry state when /api/command-center fails.
Add days_of_week selection to Class create/edit dialogs so schedule filtering is usable.
Command center: use teacher/school timezone (not UTC) for today/weekday and use assignment.points for at-risk grade averages.
Add data-testid attributes to Command Center stat cards and section panels.
critical_code_review_comments: handleUpdateClass silently drops the new schedule fields while showing a success toast - user-visible data loss.
period:'' in newClass initial state guarantees a 422 for the default create path; validate/normalize before POST.
/api/command-center performs unbounded per-class and per-assignment queries (N+1); aggregate or cache.
server.py is 5962 lines - the Command Center aggregation should be extracted into its own router/module.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (Command Center render/stats/panels/quick-actions pass; 2 Class schedule dialog defects)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted temporary classes TEST_CC_* / TEST_UI_* via API and UI; all cleaned up (cleanup_cc_test_data.py run, 0 TEST_ classes remaining).
test_credentials: test@school.edu / testpassword (login is at /auth -> 'Sign In' tab; /login redirects to landing page)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: go to /auth, click 'Sign In' tab, fill input[type=email]/input[type=password], submit -> /dashboard (Command Center). Backend regression tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_command_center.py; the single expected failure test_create_with_empty_string_period_frontend_payload documents the blank-period 422 bug and should pass after the fix. Command Center schedule is empty on Sat/Sun because days_of_week defaults to Mon-Fri; to test a populated schedule create a class via API with days_of_week=[current weekday abbrev]. Gradebook page emits pre-existing React hydration warnings (span/th/tr nesting) unrelated to this feature.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1: Classes.js initialises newClass.period to '' and posts the state object unchanged; ClassCreate.period is Optional[int] so Pydantic raises int_parsing 422 for ''. Bug 2: handleUpdateClass builds an explicit payload object that was never extended with the new schedule keys, so the PUT (which the backend does persist correctly - verified by test_update_schedule_persist) never receives them.
